_comment: A Sword of the Samurai project needs no file of its own: the game is the release's original files, which the project brings as firmware (the core's firmware list, by the release and sound settings). A project may add a saved game to start from.

slots.title: Saved game
slots.help: A TALLTALE.DAT, the game's own saved game (Alt+S at the Home Option scroll writes it): the career choices' Restore Saved Game finds it. The game writes its saves in the machine's memory, never over this file.
